chemprop_integration: Complete source-holdout Chemprop grid merged from the resumable runner.
meta_validation_policy: Do not randomly split combined meta rows. Hold out complete heldout_source groups when evaluating generalization across datasets.
prediction_storage_policy: Molecule-level source-holdout predictions and q_i labels are stored as a compressed Parquet dataset partitioned by held-out source, with bounded part files below 95 MB. A CSV copy is intentionally omitted because it would exceed GitHub's 100 MB limit.
remaining_limitation: The five source datasets overlap in chemical content. Molecule leakage is blocked within every task, but genuinely external datasets are still needed for the final publication claim.
